policy.shared_bundle_rule: A Brain/Core provider mutation must be compatible with every supported official Nuvio client generation because the published provider bundle is shared across clients.
policy.selection_rule: Prefer runtime capability detection inside generated provider code; use client version/ref gates only when a behavior cannot be detected safely at runtime.
policy.unknown_generation: fail-closed for automatic mutation capabilities not proven on the baseline generation
policy.reader_only_drift: may require native reader re-proof without invalidating provider-only capabilities
policy.provider_contract_drift: blocks automatic Brain provider mutation until audited
policy.client_runtime_equivalence: Never infer runtime compatibility from a sibling client. Desktop, Mobile and TV must each execute the shared provider/Core bundle in their own official runtime; success on one client is evidence for that client only.
policy.runtime_error_observability: Official clients may intentionally collapse getStreams JavaScript exceptions into an empty result for application resilience. Native Labs must preserve those exceptions as diagnostic evidence and must not classify the resulting empty application value as a successful runtime execution.
policy.cross_client_divergence: A single provider/client discrepancy remains Brain evidence. A systematic client-wide empty/runtime-error pattern while an official peer succeeds is a blocking runtime-contract failure.
